description: Reflect an LLM-credit outage (or its clearance) in the intention graph.

number.description: The issue or PR number the outage deferred.

state.description: 'awaiting-funds' when a credit outage defers the item; 'clear' when the canary confirms funding is restored.

url.description: Canonical GitHub URL of the issue/PR, carried from the CI run at runtime (github.server_url + repository) — never derived from a hardcoded owner. Lets the graph hyperlink straight to GitHub.

name: cypher_mark_funding_state
